programme.desc: Kultinis Vokietijos serialas, susižėręs ne vieną prestižinį apdovanojimą - už specialiuosius efektus ir scenarijų. Dviejų Berlyno greitkelių policininkų komandąjau daugybę metų „perkanda“ visokiausio plauko nusikaltėlių - kelių „erelių“ ir maniakų, plėšikų, pagrobėjų, prievartautojų, teroristų, sprogdintojų – užmačias. Pašėlusios gaudynės, pavojai kelyje – „Kobra 11“ komandos kasdienybė.

programme.title: Laukinės aistros
programme.desc: Kriminalinė drama su „Auksinio gaublio“ nominantu Kevinu Baconu. Pietų Floridos mokyklos vadovas kaltinamas moksleivės išprievartavimu. Iš pradžių daugelis mano, kad tai tėra prasimanymas, bet netrukus policiją pasiekia dar vienos merginos pranešimas. Vadovaujamas pareigas užimančio vyro padėtis tampa beviltiška. Kurioje pusėje tiesa? Ar policijos detektyvai išsiaiškins, kas kaltas? Originalus pavadinimas „Wild Things“.

programme.title: Priešprieša
programme.desc: Nesugaunamas samdomas žudikas, pravarde Niekšas, nužudo FTB agento Džeko Kaufordo partnerį Tomą Launą ir visą jo šeimą, pelenais paverčia namus, kad neliktų nė menkiausio įkalčio. Nenumaldomu keršto troškimu degantis Džekas įsisuka į mirtinų įvykių ir išdavysčių verpetą. O Niekšas įgyvendina savo planą ir sukelia karą tarp kinų gangsterių. Kas įvyks, kai kovos įkarštyje Džekas galiausiai susitiks akis į akį su Niekšu? Kokios jų praeities paslaptys tada iškils?

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 3
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin's voices may be breaking, but they're showing no signs of growing up. Whilst Gumball and Darwin make fun of Mom and Dad for being old, their voices start to break. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 3

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 3

They use their newly acquired gym skills to save the Coach from being bullied.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 3

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 3

So the kids test it out at home and end up baking a clone army whose leader - Ant-one - wants to destroy Anton and take over the world.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 3

If they can't reach him in time, the old Gumball will disappear forever and they'll be left with Zach!

The voltage drops continue, even though the sky seems clear now. Grizzy looks out the window and a dragon appears on the horizon! Once over his initial fright, the bear realizes that it's only a kite flown by the Lemmings – using the electricity from the cabin they have rerouted!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy dismantles the toboggan built by the Lemmings in the log cabin and reemploys the bamboo sticks to build a jacuzzi. When the Lemmings discover the bear's piece of work, they imagine a giant waterpark dominated by an immense waterslide. Anticipating the Lemmings' desire, Grizzy tries to barricade himself inside but the rodents manage to eject him from the cabin. The bear comes back, protected by a super bamboo armor…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize a drone race throughout the cabin. Grizzy, who was on the verge of falling asleep, interrupts the competition but must contend with the rodents' reprisals. Thrown out of the cabin, the bear falls onto a temple dedicated to the Monkey King. He appropriates the statue's powers, operating a magic cloud by remote control. Grizzy settles in on the cloud and wins the race before the Lemmings. But a cloud that flies that fast can only arouse lust…

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Alone in the jungle, Clara Tinhorn wrestles with her loneliness, until she stumbles upon a freshly hatched baby crocodile!She names the hatchling Lenny, and the two quickly bond in playful joy! When the Ranchers arrive to check on the crocodile nest, they discover the baby is gone! Furious, the mother croc, Snapfang, unleashes her wrath on the Ranchers, convinced they’ve stolen her child!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers dive deep across the ocean floor, determined to track down Jack’s long-lost rusty anchor! Their search is a success, but the moment they reach for it, the water explodes with motion! A massive plesiosaur charges at them, sending the Ranchers close to the wreck of an ancient ship! Just when a collision seems certain, the beast halts, spooked by something lurking in the depths!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard. The Baby Lemmings realize that Baby Chipmunk hates to share so they decide to get their ball back and continue their game. Baby Chipmunk’s hoard is very well protected in a hollow tree, however.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The baby lemmings have discovered a new creative passion: land art. By assembling different elements on the ground, they create a beautiful work of art that can be admired from above. Baby Raccoon is horrified by this activity, thinking that the baby lemmings are just making a mess. Baby Raccoon wants to tidy up what he perceives to be the mess made by the baby lemmings.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings invent a new building game using pine cones clipped together. Baby Beaver tries to build a hut on a flat rock in the middle of the river, but his impatience and haste prevent him from succeeding. When he discovers the Lemmings pine cone construction, a magnificent amusement park, he decides to use it as a structure for his tree house.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Ducky and Quizz steal the Bat-Signal’s one-of-a-kind lightbulb, Bam and Batwing must find a way to restore the legendary light so Batman knows when Gotham needs him.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mr. Bean thinks he’s just dug up a valuable coin in the back-garden and goes rushing off to the Museum to have it valued little knowing that it’s actually Bruiser Snr’s much-loved but valueless fake gold medallion. Bruiser Snr wants it back; and forces Bean to break back into the Museum to get it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Against his better judgement, Bean has agreed to go out on a proper date with Irma Gobb, his girlfriend. She has the perfect evening planned: a romantic film followed by a candlelit dinner for two. If only she had the perfect boyfriend to go with it.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Bean discovers Declan giving Irma a lift in his swanky new SUV. Bean is unimpressed until Declan shows off all the car’s features. Undeterred Bean professes his car superior. Declan issues a challenge – to see which car Irma will choose for her lift back to work. Bean decides his car may need a little ‘pimping’ …

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to Ireland to visit an ancient Blake family castle. As the gang becomes enchanted by the magical Emerald Isle, an angry, rampaging Giant makes them reconsider just how wonderful all the old myths and legends really are.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang visits a farm that's being haunted by a creepy Scarecrow Ghost. Fred wants to impress the farmer's daughter with his mystery-solving skills, but for some reason, this case just isn't adding up.

Once over his initial fright, the bear realizes that it's only a kite flown by the Lemmings – using the electricity from the cabin they have rerouted!
