programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: To trick Grizzy's vigilance and steal the TV, the Lemmings, disguised as traditional Chinese dancers, perform a number that leaves the bear flabbergasted. The rodents take advantage of their diversion to carry off the TV set on their airborne craft made of Chinese umbrellas. But before they can escape with their bounty, Grizzy recovers the screen. Ever as determined, the Lemmings come back after upgrading their vessel.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Annoyed by a noisy high-speed chase between the Lemmings and a raccoon, Grizzy abruptly stops the game. The players fall into empty space and land in a clearing. The impact of their crash-landing cracks a black and white tile representing Yin and Yang and a strange light pours over the raccoon. Depending on his mood, the color of his fur changes, and his excitement or calm become contagious to all those around him!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: On the way back from a fishing outing, Grizzy unwittingly brings back an electrode that controls a robot. Once activated, the gadget puts itself in the service of the bear, satisfying his each and every need. The envious Lemmings plot to take possession of this new metallic ally. They manage to evict the bear, who does not intend to take this lying down… especially when he discovers a pair of robotic arms hidden in a module that fell out of the robot!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry puts Tuffy to sleep but Tuffy sneaks out to play in his dollhouse. Tom sees Tuffy and tries to catch him. Tuffy and Jerry dress up in costumes to try and escape Tom. Tom chases them into the dollhouse but he is too big and ends up wearing the house instead.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is initially charmed when a seemingly cute seagull turns up on his windowsill. Bean feeds the gull and invites the bird inside. But it’s not long before the seagull in the flat turns out to be a cuckoo in the nest taking over Bean’s home – eating all his food controlling the TV and sleeping in his bed. Bean starts to regret taking on a new best friend in place of good old reliable Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees a new toy car in the window of the local department store Havlotts and decides he must have it. But on the way to the toy department Mr Bean gets stuck in the lift. He tries his best to entertain his fellow passengers but they aren’t very appreciative. How can Mr Bean resolve the situation and get the toy he so desperately wants?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean attempts to build a shady gazebo in the back garden on a scorching hot day. But as he digs into the ground he unearths a huge unexploded bomb. Trying to make Mrs Wicket aware of the danger and save Scrapper and Teddy from being blown to smithereens takes courage nerve and a Bean styled homemade bomb disposal kit.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to the theatre to see a performance by a celebrated hypnotist Dr Daze. Bean is super keen to come up on stage and be part of the show. But after being hypnotized Bean unknowingly leaves the theatre not realizing that he is still under the influence and certain trigger sounds have him doing silly things at unexpected and embarrassing moments.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: A leisurely stroll in the park turns into a run when Mr. Bean is chased home by an angry Mime Artist. He is lost for more words than usual when the street performer makes himself at home and insists on being wined and dined. Bean ousts the pest from his house using the only language mime artists understand.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Buff's trusty winch is knocked out of action by Poison Ivy, he must learn to improvise and come up with creative solutions on the fly.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: In this country-inspired music video, Buff the Bat-Truck shows off his strength as he tows the bad guys out of town and lifts the spirits of his fellow Batwheels with his sensitive side, all while protecting the people (and critters) of Gotham.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Unhappy about a mystery-free, three-day, cross-country train trip with the gang, Fred is pleasantly surprised to discover a monster mystery on board. He's less pleasantly surprised however, when that mystery is interrupted by a second mystery, then a third, then a fourth…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy's last jar of chocolate spread was pinched by the Lemmings, who are savoring it in secret. To localize the Lemmings hiding place, Grizzy trains a raccoon, whose sense of smell equals that of a truffle hound to detect the scent of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Wedged in his sofa to relieve his aching back, Grizzy balks at getting up. He designs clever strategies to do everything from a distance, including confiscating the Lemming's radio-controlled toy robot-transformer which he will use as a butler.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations. Only these are no longer compatible with Grizzy's nap.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather. Mr. Bean finds himself chasing an illusive ray of sunshine across town, over hills and dales, a football stadium and the English Channel.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose has a passion for little blue mushrooms (which look like a baby lemming lying on its belly), which he searches for like a truffle-hunting dog. But the baby lemmings, after seeing a butterfly disguised as a leaf, decide that day to play hide-and-seek. So when Baby Moose thinks he's going to find some mushrooms, the baby lemmings jump out of their hiding place. Baby Moose gets scared every time and decides to put an end to the baby lemmings' game.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that an ant convoy marching in formation to a berry bush and back can be turned into a fun game of “conveyor belt” for them. However, their irascible neighbor, Baby Beaver, diverts the convoy so that the ants start transporting his sticks for him instead. When Baby Castor loses control of the ants and finds himself in trouble, the Baby Lemmings come to the rescue with an even more fun game!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The baby lemmings are having a picnic but have a nasty tendency to get raspberry juice all over themselves. When one of the baby lemmings dirties baby Raccoon, who has just finished washing up, baby Raccoon decides to take matters into his own hands and wash them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Squeaks has a last minute card game at Bugs' house. Bugs is thrilled until con-artist Shifty shows up to ruin the fun.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Yosemite Sam needs a belt so he robs a men's clothing store. Bugs appears to save the day!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs comes face to face with Jack the Dog Trainer. It's up to him to rescue a pack of dogs.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A boy bird named Boyd tries to win back his girlfriend through midnight serenade. A desperate-for-sleep Bugs realizes the only way to get him to stop…is to help.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred's worst nightmare comes true when an evil spirit possesses the Mystery Machine and turns his beloved van into an unrelenting monster out to destroy him and the gang before they can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to a fancy Ice Hotel co-owned by her family where a new exhibit of ice age artifacts is opening. Things heat up, however, when a frozen Ice Man thaws out and goes on a rampage inside the hotel.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst browsing the supermarket for lovely grub, Mr. Bean’s life-long pal, Teddy, is kidnapped. Bean tracks down the nasty men responsible and finds that Teddy is not their only captive. Mr. Bean rescues a hundred teddy bears once their ears are put through an industrial sewing machine.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Jerry is feeling lonely and wishes he had a girlfriend. Spike explains spring fever to Tom and they leave him be. Jerry's mood improves when he gets a message from his brawny cousin Muscles, who has fixed him up with his girlfriend's friend for a double date.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Jerry's country cousins visit the Abbey, the cook is convinced Downton is in the midst of a vermin invasion! Cates (the butler) presses Tom into service with the threat of becoming a stable cat otherwise. Tom pursues the cunning, feisty bumpkins, and Jerry, throughout the manor, and they delight in making surprise appearances to Tom in awkward moments.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Jerry discovers the mysterious phobia cats have toward cucumbers and is inspired to try it out on Tom. After freaking Tom out repeatedly, Butch steps in to counsel Tom and help him overcome his fear, only Butch is far from immune himself. The two encounter more and more trouble as they deal with their phobia.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry and Tuffy go to the Cheese Festival. Tom is cooking in the food truck and turns Jerry into a hotdog. Tom chases after Jerry and Tuffy as they escape.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Fury faces Mr. King’s three challenges to prove his worth and show that he is the strongest.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After Kitty the Catmobile saves Bam when he's in a tight spot, Bam decides to take her on a ride along patrol in the hopes of recruiting her as a Batwheel - if he can convince her to stop playing long enough to focus on their mission!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bibi wishes she could live a rule-free life like Jestah, so she decides to only focus on having fun instead. But when her actions put Batgirl in danger, Bibi must put the fun aside to stop Harley and save her hero.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After he takes down Riddler with an impressive wheel slam move, the Batwheels give Buff the nickname Tough Buff. But Buff abruptly bristles at the name, leading the Batwheels to realize that it's not okay to call your friends nicknames that they don't like.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After being zapped by Penguin's Songinator ray, the Batwheels find themselves only able to communicate through song! They'll need to learn to harmonize as a team to defeat the musical prankster.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Taz’s birthday, so The Looney Builders build him a huge ice cream sundae. Porky worries about making a mistake and delays the build causing the ice cream to start to melt.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders race against the clock to build Cecil Turtle a new racetrack. Daffy gets caught up in his own desire to race and changes part of the build.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: George P. Mandrake hires The Looney Builders to build a T. Rex fossil. It’s Tweety’s job to place the bones with his crane, but his fear of the big dino affects his ability to get the job done.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Pauleen Penguin hires The Looney Builders to build her a home in Looneyburg. Lola soon discovers they got the design wrong and the crew has to make adjustments.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mistaken for an escaped convict, Bean is carted off to jail where he finds that, with a little imagination, prison can be quite nice actually. The real convict finds life less cosy under the thumb of Mr. Bean’s landlady.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself dogged by a young Japanese boy at the Science Museum. He takes an instant dislike to the Scallywag until he sees what the kid has in his backpack: gadgets so cool you can’t even get them in the West. So when a security guard tries to ruin their fun they run away together to... Mars!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to give the she-bear he's in love with a plastic ring which he finds really swell. But since the object was found in the trash, he needs to wash it first. And the Lemmings are using the sole bar of soap in the house as a bobsleigh.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange American Indian figurine with the power to switch the spirits of two living beings and finds himself imprisoned in the body of a caribou. He immediately tries to activate the reverse procedure, but the Lemmings steal the figurine in order to turn into a partridge and fly away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: In a casing that fell from a circus caravan, the Lemmings find a magic stick that can enchant objects and make them come alive. Grizzy is sure that a stick like that would save him a lot of work, the only problem is how to get it from the Lemmings, who have become sorcerer's apprentices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to stop the Lemmings from playing with a crate of firework rockets, Grizzy is literally carried away with them when the largest specimen shoots off. When the entire crate of fireworks explodes with a boom, they are hurled out of the atmosphere and all the way to the moon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With their endless battles over the ranger's cabin which they do not want to share, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up blowing the cabin up. Amidst the debris, they discover a strange pack: an army tent with all the necessary equipment to recreate a home in nature. It's the chance to discover the joys of camping in the wild.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings encounter a white bear which has drifted all the way to them on a chunk of ice which is slowly melting. The bear makes a fabulous rodeo partner, he just needs enough ice to keep cool. Even a few ice cubes on his head are enough. The only obstacle to this beautiful friendship is Grizzy, who considers himself master of the fridge and thus of the cabin's ice production.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy gets rid of the Lemmings by crushing them with one of the ranger's heavy trunks, which he immediately clears out of the cabin, his enemies stuck to it like stickers. What he doesn't know, is that the trunk contains a multifunction drone, complete with joystick and virtual reality headset, which enables embedded piloting. Thanks to this cutting-edge technology, the Lemmings decide to regain control of the situation!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a strange pond in an American Indian grotto that has the power to rejuvenate anyone who dips in it. They spray a bit of the water of youth onto Grizzy and he instantly turns into a harmless cub they can easily rid themselves of. But the effects of the waters are only temporary.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Before taking a nap, Grizzy locks the food cupboard to prevent the Lemmings from getting into it. And to be sure they cannot force the lock, Grizzy throws all the house tools into the ravine. The Lemmings find a crate of mini building-blocks which enables them to build a hammer... and any other object they wish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings happen on a native American Indian burial place under the ranger's cabin. When they accidentally activate a magic disk representing the earth, they are sent back in time to the prehistoric era...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a phial containing a love potion: anyone who drinks it immediately falls in love with the first creature he sees. Grizzy already imagines himself becoming irresistible in the eyes of his beloved she-bear. But that is without taking into account the Lemmings... clumsiness, and their rodeo caribou drinking the magic potion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings notice that Grizzy moves away from the jar of chocolate spread whenever he chases the fly buzzing around him. But the insect can never hold out long enough for the Lemmings to swipe the jar before being knocked out. They decide to give the fly intensive sports training.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the ranger's collection of bird calls by chance. With a simple blow of the whistle, he can attract a flock of partridges that are at his beck and call. For Grizzy, it's a super-practical way of being waited on by feathered servants, while the Lemmings see it as a golden opportunity to have a squadron which obeys at the drop of a dime.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: While fighting over a jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings set off a chain reaction which sends the jar flying into space, where it damages the space station. Amongst the debris that falls in front of the cabin, the Lemmings discover a box that cancels out gravity.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs prove their inventing skills by coming up with an age-altering time-ray. This breakthrough could change the world. If they used it for something other than chasing Lamput. Obsessed much, fellas? Wildly shooting their time-ray off in public causes a not-unsurprising amount of chaos, until the local law enforcement gets caught in the cross-fire. Looks like the Specs and Skinny are gonna be in jail till they get old the normal way.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: MoleTown has a spectacular fun fair and at its heart is a huge ferris wheel created by Mishmosh, but after Manny speeds things up, Moley has to save the day.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mrs Moley is directing a small play, with Moley cast as the hero, but his fear gets the better of him and so Manny conjures up a spell which turns all residents into their characters, now Moley must save them for real.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley and the Gardener each head off for a road trip, leaving Manny and Squirm home alone, but it isn’t long before the two of them take an adventure of their own.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mrs Moley needs a wardobe picking up from Miss Petunia, Moley and Dotty must figure out how they can transport the beast from the other side of town.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Dotty persuades Moley and Mishmosh to head out for a spot of camping, meanwhile the Gardener has his own plans.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: To Truff, making music comes effortlessly. So when he needs to put in a big effort to make a ‘forest song’, it affects him in unusual ways.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Lilit loves Chanterelle’s art so much. But when Chanterelle makes a statue of Lilit, she can’t stand it. Does Lilit tell the truth or does she just carry on pretending to like it?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Our Mushlers learn that Mushpie absolutely cannot resist an adorable look. And now everyone is using their adorable power to get Mushpie to do what they want!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chanterelle absolutely loves everything about bark-boarding... until she tries it!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Everyone thinks that Puff has done what no Mushable has ever done before – touched Muddler’s mud pile. But has he really?

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. King and Enigma clash in Kaboom City with their Ultra Strikers. The battle escalates until Kid Fury intervenes.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: After another attempt on Jerry's part to elude Tom, Jerry overhears Rick and Ginger talk about the possibility of getting rid of that useless cat.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: Spike hasn't been the best role model for his boy when it comes to being a good sport. You could even say Spike's a sore loser. That's why Spike recruits Tom and Jerry to help teach the little guy how to lose gracefully. When Tom beats Tyke at a game of tic-tac-toe Tyke puts the sore into sore loser by biting Tom's finger when Tom extends it for a friendly post-game handshake. Tom forces Jerry to take turns playing various games with Tyke (e.g. Checkers, basketball, hopscotch, etc…). Each time they win, Tyke takes it out on them. When Tom and Jerry start throwing the games, Spike's right there to dole out his own punishment for letting Tyke win. Sometimes you just can't win!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: Tuffy and Jerry are brushing their teeth. Tuffy's so tired he uses Jerry's tail instead of his toothbrush. They climb in their respective beds, only Tuffy's not in his bed, he's in the palm of Tom's hand that Tom's made-up to look like a bed. Tom gets walloped for his little stunt but it points out to Jerry that he needs a safer home. What begins with Jerry securing his home from Tom, turns into an arms race between the cat and mouse where they each build their own booby-trapped bunker to protect themselves from each other. They turn out to be their own greatest enemy, with the biggest threat coming from their own creations. In the end, they go back to their relatively safer existence.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: While using a wand to make inanimate objects come to life to attack Jerry, Tom accidentally zaps a marionette (Marie Antoin-marionette). Now the cat and mouse have more on their hands than either one of them can handle! Sure the marionette pulls Hildie and Beatie's heart-strings when they are around (both are thrilled to have another girl in the house even if she is made of wood), but the doll delights in getting Tom into trouble when the witch sisters aren't looking. When Marie becomes too much for even Jerry to bear, Tom and Jerry have to figure out how to get rid of the little hellion! They brought her into this world, now they've got to take her out!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2
programme.desc: It's summer, and Spike's the primary beneficiary of Rick's daily grilling ritual: the pooch is tossed a nice juicy T-bone nightly. When Spike gets stuck trying to exit the doghouse, he realizes it's time to back off the beef.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: To trick Grizzy's vigilance and steal the TV, the Lemmings, disguised as traditional Chinese dancers, perform a number that leaves the bear flabbergasted. The rodents take advantage of their diversion to carry off the TV set on their airborne craft made of Chinese umbrellas. But before they can escape with their bounty, Grizzy recovers the screen. Ever as determined, the Lemmings come back after upgrading their vessel.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Annoyed by a noisy high-speed chase between the Lemmings and a raccoon, Grizzy abruptly stops the game. The players fall into empty space and land in a clearing. The impact of their crash-landing cracks a black and white tile representing Yin and Yang and a strange light pours over the raccoon. Depending on his mood, the color of his fur changes, and his excitement or calm become contagious to all those around him!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: On the way back from a fishing outing, Grizzy unwittingly brings back an electrode that controls a robot. Once activated, the gadget puts itself in the service of the bear, satisfying his each and every need. The envious Lemmings plot to take possession of this new metallic ally. They manage to evict the bear, who does not intend to take this lying down… especially when he discovers a pair of robotic arms hidden in a module that fell out of the robot!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby chipmunk has a collection of pretty gems. But when she loses a round one and it rolls past the Baby lemmings, they get the idea of organising a marble run. They collect lots of objects, cut them to make them spherical and... And off they go! But when the Baby chipmunk realises she's lost her stone, she wants it back. And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose has a passion for little blue mushrooms (which look like a baby lemming lying on its belly), which he searches for like a truffle-hunting dog. But the baby lemmings, after seeing a butterfly disguised as a leaf, decide that day to play hide-and-seek. So when Baby Moose thinks he's going to find some mushrooms, the baby lemmings jump out of their hiding place. Baby Moose gets scared every time and decides to put an end to the baby lemmings' game.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Kitty is staying over at the Batcave for a sleepover, but getting her to lie down for a catnap is no easy task as the Batwheels have to find creative ways to get her to sleep.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mrs. Wicket’s Nephew is staying with her when he wins two tickets to an Outward Bound course. She refuses to go but then ropes in Bean to look after the child. The two start a competition to see who will win the trophy. Bean is a relentless competitor winning everything up until the point things start getting out of hand …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mistaken for an escaped convict, Bean is carted off to jail where he finds that, with a little imagination, prison can be quite nice actually. The real convict finds life less cosy under the thumb of Mr. Bean’s landlady.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang is honored to take part in the wedding of two close friends. But can Best Man, Shaggy, and Maid of Honor, Daphne, save their friend's perfect day before it's ruined by a tragic Ghost Bride bent on destroying everyone else's Happily Ever After?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne agrees to watch her friend's kid, Wayne, and convinces Fred to take a night off from mysteries to go to the boardwalk amusement park. Unbeknownst to her, though, the park is being haunted by a fiendish clown, Madcap.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: At nightfall, just as Grizzy starts to doze off, a racket comes from outside the cabin: the Lemmings are sliding along the Great Wall in a crate, propelled by firework rockets. Cleverly avoiding the bear's strategies to stop them, the Lemmings accidentally set off a mechanism in a tower. A secret room filled with cannons and catapults opens, just waiting to be used by the powder monkey apprentices…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread in the cabin and it ends up sinking in the lagoon. The bear makes a diving suit from various home facilities, while the Lemmings share a diving tank to put a wrench in their adversary's flippers! But the local wildlife comes to meet them…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy wakes up after a nap, starving, but the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread is empty. The cupboards are barren, except for a package of chocolate powder. Grizzy has the idea of mixing it with coconut milk. It's absolutely delicious! But the Lemmings, who are every bit as gluttonous, want their share of the choco-coco drink!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy gets a nice big bite on the end of his fishing line. While he concentrates hard to strike his catch, the Lemmings divert the fish to tow them on a kite. Grizzy tries to sabotage their improvised kitesurfing game to recover what's rightfully his, until a shark's fin appears on the horizon!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The cupboards of the log cabin are hopelessly empty and Grizzy's belly is rumbling. Through his binoculars, he observes the overexcited Lemmings slipping all sorts of small metal objects into the slot of… a Yummy vending machine!?! The bear joins them on the pontoon. If only they could find some coins to make the machine work. Maybe the solution is to find the booty indicated on the treasure map they unearthed on the beach?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After accidentally breaking his favorite sofa, Grizzy spots a cozy fishing cabin on a neighboring island. He requisitions the Lemmings' canoe to get there but discovers that the new cabin is dilapidated and lacking all comfort. The poor bear had been deluded by a poster. However, a fabulous yacht is moored nearby. It catches both his attention and that of the Lemmings, who have just disembarked on the island!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry and Tuffy go to the Cheese Festival. Tom is cooking in the food truck and turns Jerry into a hotdog. Tom chases after Jerry and Tuffy as they escape.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean's car is filthy so he gives it a good wash. His sparklingly clean car attracts the attention of other drivers who offer to pay Mr Bean to wash their cars too. Bean cannot resist and builds a car-washing contraption to help him out. But when a certain very posh visitor’s car gets damaged Bean thinks he’s for the chop.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean chases Scrapper around Mrs Wicket’s flat but her sideboard tumbles over and when Bean sees a bit of fur poking out from under it he is horrified to think he has squashed poor Scrapper. Not realizing that it’s only his landlady’s furry hat Bean rushes what he thinks is a flattened cat across town to the vets in a desperate attempt to save his feline friend’s life.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean helps Mrs Wicket collect up all her money together after she witnesses a robbery. With all her cash safely locked in a bank vault Mrs Wicket suddenly finds she has a new admirer but Mr Bean doesn’t trust this smooth operator one bit. With wedding bells ringing Mr Bean races against time to solve the mystery and save Mrs Wicket…and her money.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is painting a picture of Teddy when he accidently squirts some green paint onto his brown wallpaper. Oh no! Bean needs to redecorate his room fast but ends up painting all the walls a garish lime green instead of brown. He’s so terrified of Mrs Wicket finding out that when he goes to bed he has some very weird nightmares – with a rather sickly ending.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: It's the First Day of Spring and Mr. Bean sets about washing his clothes, his furniture, his teddy and himself. But, alas, there’s no hot water! A bit of inventive improvisation with an outside drainpipe proves Mr. Bean to be greener at D.I.Y. plumbing than he thought.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Snowy and Jestah team up to execute a mysterious plan involving rare freeze-berries, Batwing and Buff pair up to take on the dastardly duo, but Batwing decides to carry out the mission herself, putting both her and Buff at risk.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Take to the skies over Gotham with Batwing and her friend best jet-friend Goldie the Arrowplane!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang goes trick or treating on Halloween night but Velma seems to think that Halloween is a disrespect to history while Daphne, Shaggy and Scooby have the opposite opinion. Meanwhile Fred believes you can't solve a mystery on Halloween. But all is explained when the gang runs into a witch and Fred reveals that he ran into the same witch 11 years ago with his cousin.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: On a trip to Japan to visit Velma's friend, the gang comes face to face with the ancient crab monster, Kaniaku, and attempts to solve a 700 year-old mystery. Meanwhile, Daphne accidentally becomes a viral media sensation in Japan!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: When the ghost of a small town's founder returns to scare off mayoral candidates, the gang decides to run Velma as mayor to bait the ghost. They quickly discover, however, that Velma lacks the skillset to make her a popular politician!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a birthday piñata in the ranger's living room. The idea of bursting open a papier-mâché statue with a bat like it says in the instructions pleases him. The Lemmings, who prefer to use it as a toy to swing from, are determined to stop Grizzy from destroying the piñata.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Inside a mysterious cave, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a magical Game of the Goose. The events displayed in the squares that the players land on come true in real life. When Grizzy and the Lemmings realize, it's too late to stop the game.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is bothered by an object stuck in between the sofa cushions: a big fur lemming puppet glove. He puts his hand inside and has fun pretending that the puppet is strangling him. The Lemmings believe that the puppet is a Super Lemming who's stronger than Grizzy and start to obey it.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: During a great Parasaur family migration, the Ranchers spot trouble. The youngest, Sneezer, is under the weather with booming sneezes that startle even himself, causing him to bolt away in panic! Min manages to calm him down just in time! Confident, Min volunteers to nurse Sneezer back to health while also taking on Uncle Jack's HQ duties. But caring for dinos is no easy feat, especially alone!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: First impressions can be tricky, especially when a protective mama sea turtle mistakes the Jungle Jetter for a predator! The frightened mother is injured in a chase, leaving the Dino Ranchers rushing to her rescue! Back at HQ, Min carefully treats the mama's wounds while the others watch over her tiny hatchlings, safely tucked inside a pen! But one mischievous baby, Shelly, has other plans!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is shocked when Teddy receives a birthday card from Bean’s girlfriend, Irma Gobb. The bear’s Birthday had completely slipped his mind. And what do you get for the teddy that has everything? A morning in a toy shop, burgers for lunch and a slap up tea party, of course. (But only if you can afford it.)

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Chipmunk is trying to carry a ton of nuts back to her den, but climbing down the cliff with all her nuts is proving a complex task. As for the baby lemmings, they've discovered the principle of the slide and are having fun building a longer and longer one. When the baby chipmunk sees this, she sees a great opportunity to get her nuts down more cheaply.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings meet a spider and his web, which allows them to play like baby Spider-Man. They even develop a tree climbing course in the forest. Baby Beaver, for his part, has a hard time fitting branches together to build a bridge over the river. When he sees the construction possibilities offered by the lemmings' spider, he decides to steal it from them.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings knock down one of Baby Beaver's constructions, bowling style. He immediately gets angry and sends the lemmings off to play further away. But he soon runs out of branches for his construction. While he is looking for new ones, he notices that the Baby Lemmings have collected all the beautiful branches in the area to build a natural bowling alley! Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is looking forward to a day of kite flying but first he must make it out his front door when he's stuck inside with a gratuity-wanting delivery snail.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs wakes up to discover his teeth missing. He must go head to head with an ornery tooth fairy to get them back.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Wile compete in a garden grow off! It's nature versus SCIENCE! May the best man win!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs trusty GPS gets him lost in a cornfield where a very scatterbrained Scarecrow desperately tries to do his job.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang heads to Shaggy's beloved grandmother's Florida retirement home, where they learn a crazed Ape Man has been frightening the elderly residents.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Scooby runs into an old kennel mate Axel who is a highly trained Police dog who thinks mystery of the Junk yard monster is too big a case for the gang.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr Bean drives his favourite Teddy to the cinema to see his favourite movie - 'Titanic'. Now he simply has to park the car. But when you're Mr Bean, nothing's simple. His ingenious efforts to find a parking space are persistently foiled. And the clock is ticking....

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: A dim-witted cat walks into the detective agency asking for help. It seems he has lost his marbles: He's the city's champion marble player and has either misplaced his case of lucky marbles, or it's been stolen. The cat is desperate to find them before the big tournament. It's up to Tom and Jerry to retrace the cat's steps and solve this mystery.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Ginger and Rick have installed a new birdbath, and Little Quacker has taken up residence in it. Ginger forbids Tom from going out in the back and has Rick move Spike's house. The dog and cat soon unite to return Little Quacker to the pond without Ginger finding out they're responsible for sending him packing.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Little Quacker develops the ability to sing like Pavarotti. But when Tom plots to use this to win a prize on the Pets With Talent TV show, Little Quacker refuses and Jerry covers for him. As things continue to snowball, it's up to Tom to attempt saving the day.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is serving food at a diner. Jerry and Tuffy sneak in and eat the food. Tom tries to chase them out of the diner and in the end they all share a delicious treat.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge. Grizzy and the Lemmings will do everything to break up this budding romance and recover the cold sources that are rightfully theirs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears. Grizzy is now obliged to treat them like brothers as well.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine, Grizzy decides to redo the cabin’s interior design. To make sure everything is perfect, he ousts the Lemmings and their electric train. By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic stick that functions as a Yummy divining rod. Grizzy steals their stick and finds a Yummy deposit in the savanna. To take control over Grizzy’s discovery, the Lemmings set a trap to draw the bear far from the deposit and transform it into an industrial chocolate factory. Grizzy will want to recover his chocolate deposit.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: An eclipse prevents the solar panels from supplying the cabin with electricity and Grizzy is disgruntledbecause he can’t watch TV. When he discovers that the Lemmings are using fireflies to have a party withoutelectricity, Grizzy evicts the Lemmings and recovers the fireflies to fuel the solar panels. The Lemmingshappen upon a jewel that gives them total control over the fireflies.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: During training at the Hero Base, the SuperThings mistake Kid Fury for a villain because of his yellow eyes.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When a group of alley dogs, aided by a heroic stray, are saved from Catwoman by kind-hearted Buff, he brings them all back to live in the Batcave, unbeknownst to the rest of the Bat-Family.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Jestah injures herself preparing for an extreme sports competition with the other Zoomers, Bibi helps her overcome her fear of going to the mechanic so she can heal up in time to compete.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Buff's trusty winch is knocked out of action by Poison Ivy, he must learn to improvise and come up with creative solutions on the fly.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Snowy and Jestah team up to execute a mysterious plan involving rare freeze-berries, Batwing and Buff pair up to take on the dastardly duo, but Batwing decides to carry out the mission herself, putting both her and Buff at risk.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Tweety leads The Looney Builders in building a new merry-go-round at the park for the kids. His crane breaks down and his small size affects his ability to contribute to the build.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders learn that Taz accidentally destroyed his house, so they set out to build him a new one that’s smash-proof.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Looney Builders build themselves a playground, Daffy gets so excited about his section that he takes all the supplies for himself.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Mac and Tosh Gopher to build them a home underground. Daffy can’t remove rocks from the area fast enough and fails to ask for help.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny uses his excavator to dig in this music video as he tackles looney jobs across town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean cannot, for the life of him, place the face of the uninvited fat bloke on his doorstep. An old school photograph and school cap just about jog his memory. By this time his new ‘friend’ has put his feet up and is eating Bean out of house and home. This blast from the past proves to be a blasted pain in the neck.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Irma Gobb comes round to watch TV and Bean finds that liking different programmes to your girlfriend can be very bad for a relationship. After an explosive argument the TV blows up, forcing Mr. Bean to invent his own very ingenious form of home entertainment.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope – great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a magician's hat that tosses out objects stored inside beforehand with the tap of a magic wand. He decides to impress his beloved she-bear with a magician's act. But he will have to work around the Lemmings, who have the gift of coming out of the hat at the wrong moment.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to try out the brand new packaging format of chocolate spread that he discovers in the ranger's cupboard: a yummy-looking XXL jar. And he does not intend to share it with the Lemmings. After observing a chameleon toad that is able to blend into its surroundings, the Lemmings decide to make themselves invisible to attain Grizzy's treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: A magic tomahawk divides Grizzy into two identical bears with diametrically opposite personalities: one short-tempered, the other super-sweet. The Lemmings, who did not witness Grizzy's split, will have a hard time working out the behavior of their usual enemy, who seems to swing from excessive kindness to the worst trickery for no reason.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: After studying a magazine advertisement with a couple standing in front of an SUV, Grizzy imagines that if only he had a nice car, his favorite she-bear would be interested in him. He decides to confiscate the Lemmings crate on wheels and give it a serious overhaul. The Lemmings have nothing against an upgrade, as long as they remain behind the wheel!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: While chasing the Lemmings, who stole his jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy crashes into an arcade cabinet near the supermarket which displays a model fortune teller and her crystal ball. Grizzy realizes that he can foresee events that are going to happen to him in the crystal ball, and namely the traps that the Lemmings have planned for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: A newly unpacked UV tanning booth holds the place of honor in the middle of the cabin. Grizzy gets it into his head that a classy tan will help him draw the attention of the she-bear he's enamored with. When he opens the box, he discovers that the Lemmings have beat him to it and are already playing beach party inside the bed.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have turned the entire cabin topsy-turvy to organize medieval jousts with the ranger's fencing gear. Grizzy, who wishes to recover his couch, tries to straighten up, but is driven out by their fencing foils. To retaliate, Grizzy must find a blade equal to the task. He opts for a fine... frozen swordfish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: A strange object is delivered to the Ranger's cabin: an over-board! It's a latest generation skateboard which levitates above the ground without wheels. The Lemmings immediately try to get their paws on it, but Grizzy also covets the board as a table to set his TV-dinners down on.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the joys of photography with the ranger's instant print camera. Grizzy would like to make a beautiful artistic portrait of the she-bear he's in love with, whereas the Lemmings prefer a group photo with a face-making competition: two radically opposed artistic trends!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The fridge in the cabin has changed: it's been replaced by a brand new state-of-the-art appliance which analyzes the body fat percentage of whoever wants to serve himself, before selecting the appropriate foodstuffs. For Grizzy, no question of touching the chocolate spread or sodas! Instead, to the Lemmings' delight, the fridge transforms into an extreme exercise machine.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a demonstration of balloon modelling on TV. He decides to make a balloon poodle to offer to the she-bear he's enamored with. By observing Grizzy, the Lemmings discover with enthusiasm that you can blow up modelling balloons far more than regular ones, and that they end up exploding in a shower of tattered strips.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy needs a nice nap. He can't find a pillow comfortable enough to his taste until he tests the pillow that the Lemmings use as a high-jump mat. The pillow is so soft that Grizzy falls asleep the second he lays his head on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is awakened from his nap by the unpleasant, ongoing sound of Velcro strips being ripped off. The Lemmings have covered their bodies in Velcro and are throwing themselves against a doormat, which serves as their target. Grizzy finds peace and quiet by getting rid of the doormat until the Lemmings realize that bear fur is an ideal support for Velcro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The she-bear Grizzy is enamored with has lost her favorite flower in an inaccessible spot under a giant boulder. Grizzy tries to lift it: impossible! He decides to start an intensive bodybuilding routine with the ranger's electrostimulation machine, but the Lemmings are already using it on a caribou to step up their rodeo.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings try to catch a bat to play rodeo, disturbing Grizzy as he plays his favorite game on the ranger's mobile. But when the phone is hit and its alarm activated, a submarine sonar sound is emitted. When the bat hears it, it seems to become docile.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Specs and Skinny celebrate a brand new arrival to the family: a body lotion that delivers incredible speed to its wearer. Yay Science! The boys quickly include the speed lotion in their morning routine, because testing inventions on yourself is always a good idea. Then it's time to get out there and nab Lamput once and for all. Results are mixed. On the one hand, the zoom oil certainly works. On the other hand, these nerds aren't really used to having a body that can actually do things. Conclusion: the docs still fail, only this time they fail really quickly. At least they get that round the world trip they were dreaming of.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mystic Mole leaves Moley and Dotty in charge of the temple, meanwhile the Gardener hatches an ingenious plan to get his hands on Manny!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley and Dotty must track down the mysterious Beast of James Bay, meanwhile, the Gardener uses this opportunity to try out his new creature disguise to try and trap Manny.

programme.desc: „Eurojackpot“ – populiariausia ir didžiausius laimėjimus Europoje siūlanti loterija, kuri vienija net 18-os šalių žaidėjus. Žaidimai vyksta du kartus per savaitę ir jų metu dalyviai turi galimybę laimėti 10–120 mln. eurų Jackpotą. Šalia jo tik žaidėjų Lietuvoje laukia ir papildomo žaidimo „Džokeris“ laimėjimai. Ši loterija daugybę mūsų tautiečių pavertė įspūdingų sumų laimėtojais, o keletą – net ir multimilijonieriais!

programme.title: Ar galiu užeiti?

Laidoje dėmesys skiriamas visuomenę jaudinančioms, aktualioms temos ir pateikiamas platesnis suvokimo kampas. „Delfi interviu“ vedėja – patyrusi žurnalistė, ilgametė naujienų portalo redaktorė Rasa Lukaitytė-Vnarauskienė

programme.desc: Ar žinote, kaip iš tikrųjų susiformavo žemynai? Viskas prasidėjo nuo mažytės voveriuko Skreto gilės. Menkas bakstelėjimas ledyno paviršiuje baigėsi kontinentų atsiskyrimu. Po šio geografinio perversmo Mamutas Menis, tigras Diego, tinginys Sidas ir jo močiutė atsidūrė vidury vandenynų išlaikomi tik menkos ledo lyties. Bičiuliai darys viską, kad išgelbėtų savo kailius ir susitiktų kitus draugus bei šeimos narius. Kelionėje jų laukia neatrastos žemės, egzotiška gamta ir nematytais gyvūnais apgyvendintas piratų laivas! Kompanijai pavyks pasprukti nuo užpuolikų, bet šie bandys herojus pavyti ir atkeršyti. Įspūdingi nuotykiai įtrauks visą šeimą, o filmas bus puiki geografijos pamoka mažiesiems ir linksma pramoga suaugusiems. Filmą įgarsino žinomi šalies žmonės: Rimas Šapauskas (Manfredas), Arūnas Sakalauskas (Sidas), Dainius Svobonas (Diegas), Evelina Kauklienė (Elė), Džiugas Siaurusaitis (Krešas), Algis Dainavičius (Edis), Irmantas Jankaitis (Kapitonas Gutas), Elvyra Žebertavičiūtė (Močiutė), Oneida Kunsunga (Persikutė), Agne Šataitė (Šira).

programme.title: Nuo... Iki...
programme.desc: Laida, kuri apie Lietuvos žvaigždžių gyvenimus žino daugiau nei jos pačios. Laida, kuri dėl spalvingų istorijų keliauja tūkstančius kilometrų nuo Amerikos iki Azijos. Laida, kuri įkalbina garsenybes papasakoti ne tik apie savo pergales, bet ir apie pralaimėjimus. Jos atveria ne tik savo širdis, bet ir namų duris. Šiemet „Nuo...iki...“ švenčia savo 30-tąjį gimtadienį ir ta proga rodo išskirtinius įžymybių interviu ir dar daugiau įkvepiančių ar šokiruojančių istorijų.

programme.desc: Tikros ir nepagražintos istorijos tiesiai iš pareigūnų eikpažų. Jungtinių Amerikos Valstijų kriminalinio pasaulio kasdienybė, užfiksuota dokumentiniame seriale.

programme.title: Bučiuoju. Rūta
programme.desc: Kur dingo geri vyrai ir kur slepiasi ištikimos moterys? Ar barakudos dar egzistuoja, o gal rinką užėmė alfonsai? Kodėl Lietuva nyksta, jaunimas nebesvajoja kurti šeimų, o vietoje vaikų augina šuniukus ir kačiukus? Ką daryti, kad grožio bei jaunystės kultas neužvaldytų smegenų? 30 metus televizijoje skaičiuojanti Rūta Mikelkevičiūtė pasitinka žiūrovus visiškai atsinaujinusioje studijoje, kur gvildens temas nuo gyvenimo būdo iki politinių aktualijų ir saugumo mūsų valstybėje.

programme.title: Šeškinės 20. Giedriaus ir Džiugo šou
programme.desc: Ryškiausi svečiai ir charizmatiški vedėjai – Giedrius Savickas, Džiugas Siaurusaitis ir žinoma Lietuvos komikė Laura Dragūnaitė žada – laidoje netruks ir paslapties, ir komedijos, ir net detektyvo! Ar žiūrovai išlukštens intrigą ir atspės slaptą laidos svečią?

programme.title: Nuo... Iki...
programme.desc: Slaptos atostogų vietos, į kurias su savo apsauga privačiais lėktuvais skrenda pasaulinio garso žvaigždės, šių dienų aristokratai ar karališkųjų šeimų nariai. „Nuo… iki…“ ieško atsakymų, ką žvaigždės daro, kad gerbėjai negali nesižavėti jų stulbinančia išvaizda ir energija – atrodo, laikas jų tarsi neliečia, o ilgaamžiškumo paslaptys seniai žinomos. Ką apie savo pakilimus ir nuopuolius, asmeninius atradimus ar kino ekrano vertas sėkmės istorijas papasakos Lietuvos žvaigždės ir žmonės, turintys neįtikėtinų patirčių?

programme.title: KK2
programme.desc: Greita, aštri ir nepatogi – tai aktualijų laida, kuri nevynioja žodžių į vatą ir pulsuoja kartu su visuomene. Nuo socialinių įtampų iki gyvenimo absurdiškumo – čia rasite tai, apie ką visi galvoja visi, bet garsiai pasakyti nedrįsta.
